instruction_summary: Study 002 (book, GO-WITH-SCOPE): score Piore & Sabel (1984) Exit-1 prediction P2 (the reader question - is globalization a new mass-production system?) as a three-hypothesis evidence-weighing contest (H-A new mass production / H-B flexible specialization at global scale / H-C neither: the second unbundling) across seven pre-declared falsifiable signatures on 1984-2026 public data; per-cell verdicts, one overall verdict in the fixed vocabulary, NO pooled/replication score.

steps.command: uv venv /workspace/.venv && uv pip install pandas numpy matplotlib

steps.description: Gate A1b: re-grep the 6 inherited P2 anchor locators (Schwartz HTML, Berger PDF, Bhengu PDF) at run start -> all hit count=1 -> P2 anchor live
Gate A1: sha256 integrity of 13 staged data files vs PROVENANCE (13/13 match)
Declared TiVA retry (II.4, keyless): HTTP 500 across key shapes -> binding fallback (WTO GVC Report 2025 + WITS trend)
Build S1-S3 signatures (WDI VA shares, BDS via 001, Eurostat SBS 2 panels, worldsteel split, WITS SoP, mobile diffusion)
Build S4/S6/S7 + E3 discriminator + evidence grid + verdict + effective denominator

key_results.verdict: neither - the unbundling reading (the second unbundling), threshold-sensitive
key_results.verdict_route: no hypothesis reaches >=4 full favors on live cells (H-A 0, H-B 0, H-C 2); split condition met (S1 splits + S4 mixed + none >=4) AND S3 favors H-C -> routes to the unbundling verdict; dichotomy-fails condition simultaneously satisfied
key_results.S1_scale: favors H-C: China world-manuf-VA share 8.5%->27.9% (2004-23) + integrated BOF mills vs Western smallization/EAF mini-mills; US small-estab share 27.7%->37.2%(2011)->32.5%(2023); unit splits by geography & era
key_results.S2_standardization: weakly measured (all weak): smartphone diffusion (standardization) + Shein variety (company-claimed)
key_results.S3_composition: favors H-C: GVC participation rose 1995-2011 then plateaued (WTO Fig 2.8); GVC-trade share 48%->46.3%; US-China ~30% below trend since 2018. WITS SoP2 intermediate flat 19.45-24.92%
key_results.S4_governance: capped weak: captive in power (Schwartz three-layer chain) + modular/relational form (GHS/Sturgeon)
key_results.S5_skill: not separable on staged data (fixed by declaration)
key_results.S6_institutions: ex-ante-decided (documentary): 0 of 2 demand-management institutions exist; mass consumption arrived on market terms (mobile subs ~0->128 China, 131 Viet Nam by 2023)
key_results.S7_districts: partially measured: E-R persists but relative advantage declined (+29%->+19.5% vs Italy 1980-2024); 'narrow slice' (Schwartz)
key_results.E3_discriminator: not separable this tick: plant re-concentration fired (US+EU) but standardization-reversal did not; geopolitics/ICT side fired 3/3 -> one side partial + other firing -> not separable
key_results.P2_anchor: live (6/6 inherited locators hit; Schwartz+Berger+Bhengu); graded as worded, PROVISIONAL-PENDING-H1
key_results.a1_hashes: 13/13 staged data files match PROVENANCE sha256

comparison_to_original.followup: per-signature evidence grid + one verdict, no pooled score
comparison_to_original.note: absent by design; 001 is the verification layer, 002 scores P2

comparison_to_original.followup: reused; S1b adds E3 reading: rose to 37.2% (2011) then fell to 32.5% (re-concentration)
reused for S7 (district persistence as 'narrow slice', relative decline)
comparison_to_original.note: S7 weakly favors H-A and H-C, weakly against H-B

comparison_to_original.followup: 6/6 inherited P2 locators re-grepped, all hit -> anchor live
comparison_to_original.note: gate A1b re-run at run start

deviations: TiVA retry (II.4) returned HTTP 500 across key shapes at run time (endpoint degraded); binding fallback used for S3 (WTO GVC Report 2025 chapters, page-cited, + staged WITS trend). Logged in fetch_log.json.

Pre-2004 China manufacturing-VA-share cells NOT substituted: the specced source (recency-research.md 5.4 literature values) is not among this run's staged inputs; China hub finding rests on staged WDI 2004-2023.
Steel PREVIEW label stated China ~91.6% BOF; the staged worldsteel-2025 table gives China 89.8% BOF (the 91.6 is the Austria row). Reported as computed; label travels (R-6).
INDSTAT (H3) excluded (registration-gated, not staged); S1 rests on US/EU size series + hub-share data. USGS DS140 blocked, not attempted.
S5 (skill) not scored by design; S4 capped weak; S2 weakly measured; S7 partially measured (pre-declared).

Schema (PS-C2): gates.json sets replication_score=null ('not applicable (book; GO-WITH-SCOPE)'); card/summary carry no score field, so no hand-around needed; verdict-count tallies (structured) used. Reported for any pipeline-level fix per the uniform-evaluator rule.
